sql: SELECT count(*) FROM sampledata15 WHERE origin = '3'
SELECT T1.commod FROM resultsdata15 AS T1 JOIN sampledata15 AS T2 ON T1.sample_pk = T2.sample_pk WHERE T2.year = '15' GROUP BY T1.commod ORDER BY sum(T1.concen) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DISTINCT commod FROM sampledata15 WHERE origin = '2' AND commod NOT IN (SELECT commod FROM sampledata15 WHERE origin = '1')
SELECT T2.growst, avg(T1.concen) FROM resultsdata15 AS T1 JOIN sampledata15 AS T2 ON T1.sample_pk = T2.sample_pk GROUP BY T2.growst
SELECT T2.variety FROM resultsdata15 AS T1 JOIN sampledata15 AS T2 ON T1.sample_pk = T2.sample_pk WHERE T2.commod = 'AP' GROUP BY T2.variety ORDER BY avg(T1.concen) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT commod FROM resultsdata15 WHERE concen > lod
SELECT lab FROM resultsdata15 GROUP BY lab ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT T2.country FROM resultsdata15 AS T1 JOIN sampledata15 AS T2 ON T1.sample_pk = T2.sample_pk WHERE T2.origin = '2' GROUP BY T2.country ORDER BY sum(T1.concen) LIMIT 1
SELECT distst FROM sampledata15 GROUP BY distst ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT year, month, day FROM sampledata15 WHERE sample_pk = 3763
SELECT state FROM sampledata15 WHERE commod = 'AP' GROUP BY state ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT growst FROM sampledata15 WHERE commod = 'AP' GROUP BY growst ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT site FROM sampledata15 WHERE sample_pk = 3763
SELECT country FROM sampledata15 WHERE sample_pk = 6480
